frameworks: UK National Curriculum KS2 Reading Content Domains

strands.name: Retrieval
strands.description: Content domain 2b: retrieve and record information/identify key details from fiction and non-fiction.

objectives.description: Retrieve, record and present information from fiction and non-fiction texts

strands.name: Literal Comprehension
strands.description: Understanding what is explicitly stated in a text.

objectives.description: Answer questions directly using information explicitly stated in the text

strands.name: Inference
strands.description: Content domain 2d: make inferences from the text, explain and justify with evidence.

objectives.description: Draw inferences such as inferring characters' feelings, thoughts and motives from their actions
Justify inferences with evidence from the text

strands.name: Predicting
strands.description: Content domain 2e: predict what might happen from details stated and implied.

objectives.description: Predict what might happen next from details stated and implied

strands.name: Vocabulary in Context
strands.description: Content domain 2a/2f: word meaning in context, and effect of word choice.

objectives.description: Give/explain the meaning of words in context
Identify and explain how meaning is enhanced through the author's choice of words and phrases

strands.name: Author's Intent & Viewpoint
strands.description: Content domain 2g: identify/explain how structure, and choice of language, contribute to meaning.

objectives.description: Identify how language, structure and presentation contribute to meaning
Discuss the author's use of language, including figurative language, and its effect on the reader

strands.name: Summarising
strands.description: Content domain 2c: summarise main ideas from more than one paragraph.

objectives.description: Summarise the main ideas drawn from more than one paragraph, identifying key details that support the main idea(s)

strands.name: Comparison Within & Across Texts
strands.description: Content domain 2h: make comparisons within a text.

objectives.description: Make comparisons within a text, e.g. comparing characters, settings or ideas
